name: DynVB_Constructor
summary: Constructs a 0x48-byte double-buffered dynamic vertex buffer object (vtable off_1032AFD4) with two 32-byte slots zeroed.
evidence: Stores vtable off_1032AFD4, zeroes VB pointer of 2 slots (stride 32) and bytes +0x44/+0x45; allocated 0x48 bytes and followed by sub_10043E50 (CreateVertexBuffer) in sub_10044270.

name: DynVB_Destructor
summary: Destructor of the dynamic vertex buffer object: restores vtable off_1032AFD4 and releases buffers via sub_10043F00.
evidence: Stores off_1032AFD4 then calls sub_10043F00, which DynVB_Create also calls first to free existing buffers.

name: DynVB_Create
summary: Releases old buffers and creates N dynamic vertex buffers (or takes cached ones) of given vertex count and FVF.
evidence: Per slot stores FVF, capacity, stride=sub_1006A560(FVF); falls back to device vtbl+92 = CreateVertexBuffer(count*stride, 0x208 = WRITEONLY|DYNAMIC, FVF, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT, &vb) when lookup sub_1006B1D0(dword_1047BFF8) misses.

name: DynVB_Reserve
summary: Reserves N vertices in the current slot's buffer, computing lock offset/size and choosing DISCARD when the ring wraps.
evidence: Sets lockSize=n*stride, start=cursor, flags=0; if start+n>capacity then start=0 and flags=0x2000 (D3DLOCK_DISCARD); cursor=start+n. Works on slot index from sub_10043DE0.

name: DynVB_Lock
summary: Locks the reserved range of the current dynamic VB slot and returns the data pointer.
evidence: Calls VB vtbl+44 = IDirect3DVertexBuffer8::Lock(start*stride, size, &p, flags) with flags from Reserve or 0x1000 (D3DLOCK_NOOVERWRITE); returns NULL if no VB.

name: DynVB_Unlock
summary: Unlocks the current dynamic VB slot.
evidence: Calls VB vtbl+48 = IDirect3DVertexBuffer8::Unlock on slot from sub_10043DE0; shares callers with DynVB_Reserve/Lock.

name: VBPool_Constructor

evidence: Stores CYyObject_vtbl_ambiguous3, zeroes +4 and 32 bytes at +8; result stored in dword_1047BFF8, which DynVB_Create passes to the lookup sub_1006B1D0.

name: CMoTask_VT_10329C70_Destructor
summary: Destructor of task CMoTask_VT_10329C70: calls sub_1006B3B0 cleanup then the CMoTask base dtor.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous0; only caller CMoTask_VT_10329C70_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CMoDX_CreateAndInitSystem
summary: Creates the CMoDX singleton (g_pResourceMng) and initializes the effect/model subsystem: VB pool, mesh resource root, shared render resources, status manager and occlusion manager.
evidence: Allocates 7884 bytes with CMoDX_vtbl into g_pResourceMng, CMoDX_Initialize(g_pCDx), VBPool ctor, sub_10072ED0(g_pMeshResourceMng), finds 'proc' resource, Mo_InitSharedRenderResources, CMoDxStatusMng ctor, CMoOcclusionMng ctor + OcclusionMng_CreateTarget; caller App_InitScene.

name: Rand_SeedMT19937
summary: Seeds the Mersenne Twister (MT19937) state table.
evidence: Original sgenrand: fills 624 words using LCG 69069*x+1 high halves, sets index dword_10354040=624; Mo_InitSharedRenderResources passes 4357, the reference default seed.

name: Mem_AllocWithHeader12
summary: Allocates a block with a 12-byte header and returns the pointer past the header.
evidence: sub_10028640(a1+12, a2) + 3 dwords; paired with sub_1006C110 which frees (p-12).

name: Mem_FreeWithHeader12
summary: Frees a block allocated with a 12-byte header.
evidence: sub_10028700(p - 12); counterpart to sub_1006C0F0; callers CMoElemFamily_SharedCleanup and generator dtor.

name: CMoOcclusionMng_Constructor
summary: Constructor of CMoOcclusionMng: creates a 16x16 lockable render target in the scene texture's format.
evidence: Stores CMoOcclusionMng_vtbl, CAcc_Constructor(+8); texture vtbl+60 GetSurfaceLevel(0), surface vtbl+32 GetDesc, Release; device vtbl+100 = CreateRenderTarget(16,16,desc.Format,0,TRUE,this+0x18).

name: CMoOcclusionMng_Destructor
summary: Destructor of CMoOcclusionMng: releases the 16x16 render target and destroys the CAcc member.
evidence: Stores CMoOcclusionMng_vtbl, Release (vtbl+8) on +0x18, CAcc_Destructor(+8); only caller CMoOcclusionMng_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: OcclusionQuery_Init
summary: Zeroes an occlusion query member (surface pointer +4, word +2).
evidence: Two stores; placed in unit_1006C210_Occlusion; used by CMoElem and CXiSkeletonActor ctors; +4 is the surface that OcclusionMng_Prepare AddRefs.

name: OcclusionQuery_Release
summary: Releases the surface reference held by an occlusion query member.
evidence: Calls vtbl+8 (Release) on this[1] if non-null; does not null it; called from CMoElemFamily_SharedCleanup and CXiSkeletonActor_DestructorBody.

name: OcclusionMng_Prepare
summary: Creates the 16x16 occlusion target on first use, reads the scene target surface desc, and caches an AddRef'd pointer to the target in the query.
evidence: Agrees with DancingMad 'OcclusionMng_Prepare': calls OcclusionMng_CreateTarget if dword_1047C004+12 is 0, GetSurfaceLevel/GetDesc/Release, stores dword_1047C004+24 with AddRef (vtbl+4); caller Occlusion_QueryScreenRect.

name: CMoProcessor_Vec3Normalize
summary: Normalizes a 3-float vector in place (no-op on zero length).
evidence: sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z), multiply each by 1/len; CMoProcessor vf041.

name: CMoProcessor_Vec4TransformB
summary: Transforms a 4D vector by a 4x4 matrix (row vector * M).
evidence: out[i] = v.x*M[0][i]+v.y*M[1][i]+v.z*M[2][i]+v.w*M[3][i]; identical body to vf017's helper; reached from CMoProcessor vf018.

name: CMoProcessor_Vec4Transform
summary: Transforms a 4D vector by a 4x4 matrix (row vector * M).
evidence: Same math as D3DXVec4Transform; reached from CMoProcessor vf017.

name: CMoProcessor_Vec3Transform
summary: Transforms a 3D point (w=1) by a 4x4 matrix to a 4D result.
evidence: out = (x,y,z,1)*M incl. translation row M[12..15], like D3DXVec3Transform; reached from CMoProcessor vf016.

name: CMoProcessor_ProjectPointsToScreen
summary: Projects an array of 3D points through a world and a view-projection matrix to screen x/y, storing w as the third value.
evidence: For each vec3: M1 then M2, w stored at out+8, 1/|w| (w=0->1), x=(x/w+1)*a6, y=(1-y/w)*a7; 12-byte output stride; CMoProcessor vf032.

name: CMoProcessor_CalcScreenBounds
summary: Computes the screen-space bounding rectangle of a strided point array under a matrix and the current view-projection.
evidence: Transforms by a5 then g_pResourceMng+2832 matrix, scales by viewport half size (+3520/+3524), tracks min/max starting from +-10000; writes [minX,minY,maxX,maxY]; uses g_pProcessor scratch matrix stack.

name: CMoProcessor_ProjectVertsAndBounds
summary: Projects 9-float vertices to screen, writing screen x/y into each vertex (+28/+32), and returns their bounding rectangle.
evidence: Two matrix transforms, perspective divide, scale by a6/a7, stores into a2[7]/a2[8], min/max into a1; CMoProcessor vf033.

name: CMoProcessor_CalcScreenBoundsAndVisible
summary: Computes the screen bounds and depth range of a point set and counts points that land inside the viewport.
evidence: Builds combined matrix via g_pProcessor vtbl+36(a5,a6); tracks z/w min/max into this+678/679 and counts points within [0,2*a7]x[0,2*a8] into this+677; rect into a2.

name: CMoTask_VT_1032C490_Destructor
summary: Destructor of task CMoTask_VT_1032C490: restores vtable and runs the CMoTask base dtor.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous31 then sub_100747C0; callers CMoTask_VT_1032C490_ScalarDeletingDtor and sub_10071180.

name: ResHandle_FreeIfUnreferenced
summary: Forwards the resource handle stored in *this to MoRes_FreeIfUnreferenced.
evidence: Body is sub_10073B20(*this); 28 callers including App_Destructor.

name: CMoAttachments_VT_1032C4E8_ScalarDeletingDtor
summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a task with a CMoAttachments mixin at +0x44: releases the attachment, runs the task dtor and frees.
evidence: ReleaseSubObjectIfPresent(this+17), CMoTask_VT_1032C490_Destructor, SharedDeleteHelper if flags&1; reached via CMoAttachments_VT_1032C4E8_vf001.

name: CMoAttachments_VT_1032C628_ScalarDeletingDtor
summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a CMoResource subclass with attachments mixin at +0x30.
evidence: ReleaseSubObjectIfPresent(this+12), CMoResource_Destructor, SharedDeleteHelper if flags&1; reached via CMoAttachments_VT_1032C628_vf001.

name: CMoResource_VT_1032C588_ScalarDeletingDtor
summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the CMoResource subclass with vtable 1032C588 (mixin at +0x30).
evidence: Same body as the 1032C628 variant; reached via CMoResource_VT_1032C588_vf012.

name: CMoResource_Destructor
summary: Base destructor of CMoResource: destroys/unlinks the resource and frees its handle slot in the mesh resource manager.
evidence: Stores CMoResource_vtbl_ambiguous19, CMoResource_Destroy (sub_100721F0), sub_10074180(g_pMeshResourceMng, this[5]); called by 28 CMoResource_VT_* scalar deleting dtors.

name: CMoResource_AddRefChain
summary: Increments the 15-bit reference count of a resource and every parent up to the root.
evidence: Increments (+24 & 0x7FFF) preserving bit 15, follows parent handle at +40 until the parent is itself; 47 callers incl. App_InitScene, Frame_Render.

name: CMoResource_ReleaseChain
summary: Decrements the 15-bit reference count of a resource and its parents up to the root, clearing bit 15 at the root when it reaches zero.
evidence: Validates handle via sub_100741E0(g_pMeshResourceMng,...), decrements (+24 & 0x7FFF), walks parent handle +40; counterpart of the AddRef loop; 49 callers.

summary: Gets a related resource via sub_10072240, increments its field +0x1C and returns a pointer to its +4 member.
evidence: v1=sub_10072240(this); v1[7]++; return v1+1; callers include TexRes_LoadBm2. What sub_10072240 returns is not shown.

name: CMoResource_RegisterInTypeList
summary: Registers a resource once: allocates its handle and links it at the head of its per-type list and the global resource list.
evidence: Skips if flag 0x8000000 in +36; MeshResourceMng_AllocHandle; type=(+36&0x7F, >=0x61->4) indexes dword_1047CF80; links +16/+44; sets 0x8000000; callers CMoGeneratorClone_CreateInstance, MeshResourceMng_ResolveTree.

name: CMoResource_Destroy
summary: Destroys a resource once: marks it dead, unlinks it and, if it owns its handle, frees the handle and deletes the object.
evidence: Guard/set flag 2 at +26; sub_10073B80 unlink; if flag 1: clear, sub_10074180 frees handle, vtbl+24 deleting dtor(1); called by CMoResource_Destructor and sub_10073B20.

name: CMoResource_GetParent
summary: Returns the parent resource from the parent handle at +0x28, or this if the resource is its own root.
evidence: Reads *(this[10]); compares with this; same parent link that the AddRef/Release chain loops walk.

name: CMoResource_FindByTypeAndId
summary: Looks up a resource of a given type and FourCC id under this resource with a fresh search serial; returns the handle via out param.
evidence: Calls sub_100722C0(this,out,type,id,++dword_1047D130); 54 callers using e.g. type 7 with 'proc' or 'vmad'/'vsim'/'vcur' ids.

name: CMoResource_FindInScope
summary: Walks the sibling chain from a resource, respecting nested open(type 1)/close(type 0) blocks, to find one matching type and/or id; returns its handle.
evidence: Type=+36&0x7F, id=+32, next via handle at +8; a3==0 matches id only, a4==0 matches type only; outputs v4[5] (handle) or 0.

name: CMoTask_VT_1032C908_Destructor
summary: Destructor of task CMoTask_VT_1032C908: frees two owned buffers and decrements a global instance counter.
evidence: Stores CMoTask_vtbl_ambiguous33, operator_delete on +0x38 and +0x45, --dword_1047D138, sub_100747C0; only caller CMoTask_VT_1032C908_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: MeshResourceMng_LoadSystemResources
summary: Loads the root resource set into the mesh resource manager and caches well-known system resources (type 27 block with 'vmad','vsim','vcur' entries, and id 52743).
evidence: Stores root at this+262152 and AddRefs; sub_100731B0(this,..,27) -> dword_1047D118, then CMoResource_FindByTypeAndId type 7 ids 0x766D6164/0x7673696D/0x76637572 into dword_1047D108/120/11C; sub_100731B0(52743)->dword_1047D104; called from CMoDX setup.

name: MoRes_FreeIfUnreferenced
summary: Destroys a resource (and, if its root is not locked, the root's children) when its reference count is zero.
evidence: If (+24 & 0x7FFF)==0: if flag 4 just CMoResource_Destroy; else via sub_10072240 walks child list destroying each, then destroys the root; unit unit_10073750_ResourceIter.

name: MeshResourceMng_AllocHandle
summary: Returns the resource's handle, allocating one from the manager's free list if it has none.
evidence: If a3+20 null: pop free list (this+4), set slot to resource, store in a3+20, increment count at this+65539*4; outputs handle or 0 when the list is empty.
